title: Guard ref.read calls after the cached-profile await in TutoredChildrenSection._fireEntryPullAndNavigate
why: showProfileSwitcherSheet (profile_switcher_sheet.dart:43-50) calls showModalBottomSheet with neither isDismissible nor enableDrag overridden, so the sheet stays swipe/backdrop-dismissible for the whole window between the user's tap and the loading dialog appearing. The cached-mirror check at line 503 is a local DB read awaited BEFORE any dialog/barrier goes up; if the user swipes the sheet away during that window, _TutoredChildRow (a ConsumerWidget) unmounts, and the very next lines (514-516) call ref.read on a WidgetRef whose element is gone, outside any try/catch, so the exception would be unhandled. The same risk exists after the second await (svc.pull(...), up to 15s) at ~595. The author was clearly aware of this exact class of bug elsewhere in the same method (router is captured eagerly at line 487 specifically to survive unmounting; context.mounted is checked before every Navigator/ScaffoldMessenger call afterward) but the same treatment wasn't applied to these ref.read calls.
recommendation: Check context.mounted (or capture the needed notifiers before the await) before touching ref post-await, matching the pattern already used for `router` in the same method.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test drives _enterTalmidView, dismisses the switcher sheet while the getTutoredProfile future is pending, completes the future, and asserts no uncaught exception is thrown
ref is not touched after an await without a liveness check anywhere in _fireEntryPullAndNavigate

corrections: Evidence line 515 quote '.read(resolvedTutoredLocalProfileIdProvider.notifier)' is actually on line 516; line 515 is the bare 'ref' token.
